Name: iguana_acs_fix
Desc:
A mod, consisting of fixes for Amazing Cultivation Simulator, tries to avoid content/functional changes.

[Current fixes]
Listed in the README.MD, available on the repository.
https://github.com/iguanacore/iguana_acs_fix

[Notes]
Due to the way certain fixes are implemented, ModLoaderLite is a prerequisite. It's not listed as a prerequisite, because there are multiple versions available at this time.
Ensure that this mod is loaded after ModLoaderLite, and restart after enabling or disabling it.
Restarting is required for changes related to assembly loading, and reduces reduces any possible bugs related to enabling the Mod and directly going ingame.

This mod is hosted and updated on the repository link mentioned above, any other alternative mirrors (like Steam Workshop) can be outdated.
